projects.title: ApplyVault
projects.summary: A full-stack job application tracking system that helps users manage and monitor their job applications.
projects.description: ApplyVault is a web-based job application tracking system designed to help users organize and manage their job search activities. Users can add, update, view, and delete job application records and track their application status. The application is built using React.js for the frontend, Spring Boot and Java for the backend, RESTful APIs for communication, and MySQL for data storage.
features: Add, update, view, and delete job applications.
Track application status across different stages.
RESTful API integration between frontend and backend.
Responsive user interface built with React.js.

projects.title: FitSphere - Gym Management
projects.summary: A full-stack gym management system for managing memberships, attendance, and gym operations.
projects.description: FitSphere is a web-based gym management application developed to simplify gym membership workflows, attendance management, and subscription tracking. The application uses React.js for the frontend and Java with Spring Boot for the backend, with MySQL for database management. It provides a responsive interface for managing gym-related information and streamlining day-to-day operations.

projects.title: FestMate Web App
projects.summary: A full-stack event management web application for managing events, user registrations, and schedules.
projects.description: FestMate is a full-stack event management platform built using the MERN stack. It allows users to manage event registrations and track event schedules through a responsive web interface. The application includes JWT-based authentication, secure password hashing, MongoDB database integration using Mongoose, and RESTful APIs developed with Express.js.

projects.description: A clean, user-friendly web application that generates cryptographically strong passwords tailored to user preferences. Users can configure password length, include or exclude character types, and copy the result to the clipboard with a single click.
